source.publisher_SHA256: NOT_OBSERVED; local SHA256 will be computed only if downloaded
source.metadata: Retained official dumpstatus.json, original metadata retrieval receipt, acquisition-options exact pins verified; successful exact native range requests validate currently observed source endpoint. No new availability request in preparation.

purpose: Acquire native revision wikitext and page/revision identity with original names/values retained, avoiding fidelity loss in previously flattened Wikipedia text. This is a source-fidelity supply option, not approval of its content or model size.

cost.estimate_limit: One measured index transfer, not a promise, bandwidth guarantee or confidence interval; source congestion/laptop sleep/network interruption can fail once and charge retained bytes without retry.
cost.separate_supervisor_full_file_rehash: One additional local sequential read of26.668GB, within same8h cap. No full XML expansion to disk.

future_processing_required_not_executed_.stage: Bounded native streaming frame pilot before full corpus pipeline
steps: Read original document header/siteinfo and actual namespace/model/slot schema; never invent namespace from fragment.
Use bounded BZ2 member streaming, complete EOF/CRC/trailing checks; reconcile index compressed-offset groups and page identities.
Preserve original page/revision/sourceURL/text hashes and compressed group locations; frame all encountered page types before selecting prose.
Detect duplicate page/revision IDs and redirect/alias families globally with disk-bounded index; choose explicit spill/cap before execution.
Native index is a ROW frame. Namespace0/nonredirect is not synonymous with prose/article/English/quality. Metadata-only counts first; no all-index-row-as-article extrapolation.
future_processing_required_not_executed_.unallocated_cost: Complete decoded byte total, module/template dependency footprint, full framing wall/RSS and framedDB size are not measured. The0.225s selected-fragment capture cannot be extrapolated to a full archive.

future_processing_required_not_executed_.stage: Scoped text rendering and yield development
steps: Review captured5 pending native records completely before choosing a rendering profile; preserve names/numbers/template parameters and inline adjacency.

Unresolved templates/Lua/transclusions, infoboxes/media/tables/math/references and their dependent paragraphs receive explicit holds or complete faithful rendering; never silently strip and claim complete prose.
Separate complete narrative prose from lists/disambiguation/navigation/bibliography; retain exact source components in provenance.
Freeze profile using development records, then fresh independent acceptance and exact saved-output language/token checks; assess source/family/protected overlap before any admission.
future_processing_required_not_executed_.processing_ceiling: Keep compressed archive as canonical raw; never expand whole XML to16GB scratch. Current combined64GB policy leaves about29.9GB additional intake headroom after full archive at snapshot; any later derived output needs its own numerical reservation. No derivative allocation is made here.

rights_and_diversity.source_group: Wikimedia; same group as Wikibooks and flatWikipedia, not independent source diversity.
rights_and_diversity.required: Actual perrecord attribution, revision/history links, imports/thirdparty/licenseversion notices and derivative/sharealike release obligations remain gated under existing rights evidence. Current-revision XML is not a complete author history or a blanket license clearance.

approval_boundary: Only preparation authorized. Parent must review finite benefit versus duration/processing uncertainty and separately dispatch exact command. This proposal does not request user budget expansion or training approval. M1terminalstop and separate M3input/tokenizer/probebudget gates stay intact.
